name: context7
description: Pulls verified, up-to-date library and framework documentation to eliminate API hallucinations across modern tech stacks (React 19, Next.js 15, Tailwind v4, Python 3.12, Node.js 22).

capabilities.description: Search current library documentation and return verified API references.
Retrieve package metadata, exports, and TypeScript type signatures from package registries.
Check whether a proposed method, function call, or parameter exists in the target library version.
Retrieve canonical, tested code examples for complex integration patterns.
Inspect breaking changes, deprecated methods, and migration guides between two versions.
